name: Mechanical Relations Ep 2
summary:
Another small adventure of a spacefaring T4T lesbian couple working their dead-end job.

"Episode 2: Restrained Delight"
Fritter and Marmalade switch to making on-planet deliveries, but Fritter is still worried about things going awry...

When their job brings them to an unexpected location and leaves Fritter speechless, Marmalade gets inspiration for how to help her girlfriend stop thinking so much.
